<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Set count and perPage on Root. Project the current page through page and handle pageChange. Page parts receive the page data as an input.

## Usage

```ts
import { pagination, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/pagination';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/pagination`. It [registers](../../registration/) 9 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-pagination-root"></a>

### `shadcn.Pagination.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Pagination`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | **Required** · Default `0` |
| `page` | `number` | Default `1` |
| `perPage` | `number` | Default `10` |
| `siblingCount` | `number` | Default `1` |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `loop` | `boolean` |  |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
